change.title: New Claude API version 2026-10-21 (anthropic-version header); SDKs older than the new majors keep sending 2023-06-01

source.quote: This guide lists the code changes for moving from API version `2023-06-01` to `2026-10-21`.

tasks.reasoning:
The repo uses the Python anthropic SDK with an unbounded constraint (>=0.18.0) in requirements.txt. Older SDKs keep sending 2023-06-01, but a fresh install resolves to the newest major. The change notes indicate Python v1.0 exists and has dropped legacy APIs, so it presumably sends 2026-10-21 by default. Under that version, the temperature argument at line 561 returns a hard 400, which breaks the Anthropic provider path for code reviews.

Uncertain: confirm which Python anthropic release first defaults to 2026-10-21. The migration agent should do one of the following:
- remove temperature/top_p/top_k from Anthropic requests and confirm the parsing in _parse_anthropic_response still matches the new version's response shape, or
- at minimum, cap the dependency (e.g. anthropic<1.0) until that work is done.
This task also resolves these changes. Handle each in the same change, and say in the PR how:
- anthropic:2026-10-21-sampling-params-removed (field-removed): In API version 2026-10-21, temperature, top_p and top_k in Messages and Batch requests return 400. The 400 on temperature/top_p/top_k only applies once requests carry anthropic-version 2026-10-21. The fix is to drop temperature from messages.create at llm_client.py:561, which is part of moving to the new API version.
  Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/migration-2026-10-21.md
  "In `2026-10-21`, a request that sends `temperature`, `top_p`, or `top_k` returns a 400 error, even at the parameter’s default value."
- anthropic:2026-10-07-haiku-5-5-breaking (other): Code written for Haiku 4.5 can break on claude-haiku-5-5 (budget_tokens, sampling params, prefill, computer_20250124 return 400). The only Haiku 5.5 break this repo could hit is temperature sent at llm_client.py:561, and the version task removes it. The repo sends no budget_tokens, assistant prefill or computer_20250124 tool.
  Source: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/release-notes/api
  "Code written for Claude Haiku 4.5 can break on Claude Haiku 5.5."

callSites.why: messages.create sends temperature. Under API version 2026-10-21, any temperature (even the default) returns 400, so every non-streaming Anthropic review call would fail.
messages.stream goes through the same client and anthropic-version header. Verify it does not pass temperature/top_p/top_k and that stream handling still works under the new version.
The AsyncAnthropic client is built here. If needed, pin the anthropic-version header, or the SDK version, explicitly here.

record.prBody:
## New Claude API version 2026-10-21 (anthropic-version header); SDKs older than the new majors keep sending 2023-06-01 [Verified]

### Change

Removed `temperature` from the Anthropic `messages.create` call in `_call_anthropic` (backend/llm/llm_client.py). Raised the requirement to `anthropic>=1.0.0`. Added tests/test_anthropic_version.py. It drives the real `LLMClient._call_anthropic` through a mocked transport and asserts the request has no temperature, top_p or top_k, that the `anthropic-version` header is 2026-10-21, and that the parsed text is "hi". This also covers the Haiku 5.5 item: temperature was the only break this repo could hit, and the repo sends no budget_tokens, prefill or computer tool. The streaming call already sent no sampling params.

Files touched:
- `backend/llm/llm_client.py`
- `requirements.txt`
- `tests/test_anthropic_version.py`

### Why

API version 2026-10-21 returns 400 for temperature, top_p and top_k. The unpinned `anthropic>=0.18.0` already resolves to a new major that sends that version by default (2.4.0 installed in the sandbox).

> This guide lists the code changes for moving from API version `2023-06-01` to `2026-10-21`.

Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/migration-2026-10-21.md

### Proof

| Check | Before | After | New failures |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| pytest | fail (1) | fail (1) | 0 |
| anthropic-version | fail (1) | pass | 0 |

New failures: 0

Checks added by the agent (they count toward proof; check that each command really tests the change):
- anthropic-version, added by the agent: `export LLM_PROVIDER='mock' GEMINI_API_KEY='placeholder' OPENAI_API_KEY='placeholder'; export LLM_PROVIDER=mock GEMINI_API_KEY=placeholder OPENAI_API_KEY=placeholder; python3 -m pytest tests/test_anthropic_version.py -q` (fail (1) → pass)

Provider validators: none run.

Prepared before the baseline:
- Before the baseline the harness ran `if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then python3 -m pip install -q --only-binary=:all: -r requirements.txt || python3 -m pip install -q --only-binary=:all: GitPython; else python3 -m pip install -q --only-binary=:all: GitPython; fi` (Test collection fails with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'git' (GitPython). The Python dependencies were never installed, so install the repo's requirements. If that fails, fall back to GitPython alone, using wheels only so no build scripts run.); it exited 0.
- Checks ran with placeholder env: LLM_PROVIDER, GEMINI_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY.

Test of this change: `anthropic-version`, written by the agent and run with the checks.

Where checks ran: Docker container python:3.12-bookworm; install scripts disabled; no host env or mounts besides the repo copy; no credentials, so no live API calls

### Unproven

- No live call was made.
- Which SDK release first defaults to 2026-10-21 was not confirmed; 2.4.0 sent it in the test.
- `stream_response` passes `stream=True` to `messages.stream()`. That predates this change and was not touched or tested, so check it.
- `_parse_anthropic_response` keeps only the last text block (`text = block.text`). This is unchanged and was not checked against the new response shape beyond a simple text block.
- The pre-existing test collection error (no module named 'git') comes from GitPython missing from the sandbox, not from this change.
- The default model ids may be deprecated; I left them unchanged.
- I did not run the openapi/search validators.
- pytest was already failing before the change and still fails.
- No provider validator was run.

### Behaviour changes

- `config.temperature` is no longer sent to Anthropic. It is still used for the other providers, so for Claude it is now a dead setting.
- requirements.txt now needs anthropic>=1.0.0.

review.summary: The diff removes `temperature` from the kwargs built for the `messages.create` call (llm_client.py ~line 548), bumps `anthropic` to >=1.0.0 and adds a mock-transport test. I have three concerns. First, the second named call site, `messages.stream` at line 613, falls in the truncated part of the file, and the diff does not touch it. If it builds its own kwargs with temperature, streaming will still send it. Second, pytest fails both before and after (1 failure each), so the suite does not prove the change works. A `verified` grade does not match that. Third, I cannot confirm from the quoted source that 2026-10-21 rejects temperature/top_p/top_k, or that anthropic 1.0.0 is the major that sends the new header. The quote only says the guide lists code changes, and the other changes it may list are not addressed here.

concerns.issue: The named call site `messages.stream` at line 613 is not in the diff. The visible change only edits the kwargs dict around line 545. If the streaming path builds its own request with `temperature` (or top_p/top_k), it will still send it, and on 2026-10-21 that would return 400 if the PR's claim is right. The new test only exercises `_call_anthropic` (create), not streaming.

pytest fails 1 before and 1 after. Nothing shows which test fails, so it could be this new test (e.g. the header assertion if the installed SDK still sends 2023-06-01) or a pre-existing failure. Either way, the `verified` grade is not backed by a green suite.

I could not confirm from the quote that 2026-10-21 rejects sampling parameters. The PR only shows the code comment saying so. Removing `temperature` changes behaviour: `self.config.temperature` is now silently ignored for Anthropic. Any user-configured low temperature (e.g. 0.2 for deterministic reviews) is lost with no warning. Check the migration guide's exact wording, and whether it rejects these parameters outright or only for some models or combinations.

`anthropic>=1.0.0` assumes 1.0.0 is the first SDK major that sends `anthropic-version: 2026-10-21`. I could not confirm this. Check the SDK changelog and release notes. A major bump may also change response types or client options (`with_options(http_client=...)`), which affect `_parse_anthropic_response` and the stream code.

The migration guide likely lists several code changes. This PR handles only sampling params. Other changes the guide lists (request or response shape, stream event types, tool formats) are not reviewed against `_convert_messages_for_anthropic`, `_parse_anthropic_response` or the stream handler.

The `import httpx2 as httpx` fallback is unusual. I could not confirm that the new SDK uses an `httpx2` package. If the SDK's http_client type differs from what is passed, the test may fail for unrelated reasons. The test is also mock-only: no live call proves the API accepts the request.

## claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 retires on the Claude API Nov 30, 2026; use claude-sonnet-5-5 [Not affected]

### Change

No changes made. The repo never names claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 or the claude-sonnet-4-5 alias.

No files changed.

### Why

The retirement covers only claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929. A search of the whole repo for sonnet-4-5, sonnet-4.5 and 20250929 found no matches. The Anthropic model ids in the repo are claude-sonnet-4-20250514 (default in llm_types.py:46, plus llm_client.py:45, 641 and 755), claude-opus-4-20250514 and claude-haiku-3-5-20241022. These are different models, and this retirement does not name them. The repo sends no thinking parameter. The only tool_choice is "auto" (llm_client.py:538), so the Sonnet 5.5 breaking params do not apply.

> | November 30, 2026 | `claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929` | `claude-sonnet-5-5` |

Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/model-deprecations.md

### Proof

| Check | Before | After | New failures |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| pytest | pass | pass | 0 |

New failures: 0

Provider validators: none run.

Prepared before the baseline:
- Before the baseline the harness ran `python3 -m pip install -q --only-binary=:all: GitPython` (tests/test_builtin_tools.py imports agent.tools.builtin.github_tool, which does `from git import Repo`. The GitPython package that provides `git` is not installed, so collection fails.); it exited 0.
- Checks ran with placeholder env: LLM_PROVIDER, GEMINI_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY.

Where checks ran: Docker container python:3.12-bookworm; install scripts disabled; no host env or mounts besides the repo copy; no credentials, so no live API calls

### Unproven

- The default claude-sonnet-4-20250514 is an older model with its own retirement schedule. I did not check that schedule or change the id, because it is outside this task.
- I did not run the repo's tests. I made no edits, so there was nothing to prove.
- The claude-3-5-sonnet entry in the Streamlit UI model list (frontend/streamlit_app.py:471) is not covered by this retirement. I left it alone.

### Behaviour changes

None intended.
